description: This source file contains unit tests for the DeviceHandler class in the Android application, verifying various device information and permission handling functionalities.

classes.name: DeviceHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests verifying the behavior of DeviceHandler methods in an Android context.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo_returnsStablePayload
methods.description: Tests that handleDeviceInfo method returns a payload with expected device information.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Verifies the shape and values of the device status payload.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Checks that device permissions payload contains correct permission states.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsSendOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Verifies that partial SMS capabilities are treated as granted when send permission is granted.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsReadOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Verifies that partial SMS capabilities are treated as granted when read permission is granted.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsNoSmsGrantAsDenied
methods.description: Ensures SMS capability is denied when neither send nor read permissions are granted.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsDisabledSmsAsDenied
methods.description: Ensures SMS capability is denied when SMS is disabled.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsMissingTelephonyAsDenied
methods.description: Ensures SMS capability is denied when telephony is unavailable.

methods.name: isSmsPromptable
methods.description: Determines if SMS permissions should prompt the user based on current permissions.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions_marksCallLogUnpromptableWhenFeatureDisabled
methods.description: Checks that call log permission is marked unpromptable when feature is disabled.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Verifies the shape and content of the device health data payload.
